summary: You cannot miss whether a commit worked, and new department groups commit reliably.

new.title: Commit results in the middle of the screen
new.text: A failed or refused commit now shows a red box listing the errors and exactly what was and was not saved. A successful commit shows a green summary.

fixes.title: New department groups commit reliably
fixes.text: A new group for a department that already had an owner entry could be refused while its assignments were saved, blocking later commits. Existing data is corrected automatically during the update.

fixes.title: Commit all saves definitions first
fixes.text: Commit all now writes definitions before assignments, so a definition that cannot be saved stops the commit before anything that depends on it is written.
